items.title: Musk Says Owners’ Tesla Robotaxi Trials “May Start” Next Month. That’s a Threat to Uber
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said on Monday that trials letting Tesla owners add their own cars to the Robotaxi network may start next month, if things go well. Owners’ cars would let Tesla grow its fleet without buying the cars, as it guides to about $20 billion of capital spending this year.
